Header file:
#include "ara/per/read_write_accessor.h"
Description:
ReadWriteAccessor is used to read and write file data.
For unformatted writing it provides the write() method and for formatted writing it provides the
operator<<. It also provides the ability to force an fsync to flush the buffer of the operating
system to the storage.
